name: Lost Deathstalkers
summary: In northern Silverpine, two Forsaken scouts have been missing for weeks. High Executor Hadrec sent Rane and Quinn Yorick to watch the abandoned farms, and now you seek word of them.

sections.title: A Silence from the North
sections.body: At the Sepulcher, High Executor Hadrec has heard nothing from Rane and Quinn Yorick for weeks. He sent the pair into northern Silverpine Forest to watch the abandoned farms and track enemy movements. Deathstalkers are the Forsaken’s hidden scouts and killers. They serve Lady Sylvanas, and Hadrec fears the Scourge or another threat has cut them down.

sections.title: The Northern Peril
sections.body: Northern Silverpine lies between Lordaeron’s ruined estates and the shadowed borders of Tirisfal Glades. Undead roam there, beasts prowl, and feral worgen make travel perilous even for seasoned rogues. Search the decaying farmsteads where Rane and Quinn Yorick began their survey. Any intelligence they gathered may be vital, if danger has not overtaken them first.

sections.title: Trapped in the Shadows
sections.body: Rane and Quinn Yorick are alive, but trapped at a farm and struggling to escape. They fled an attack by the ghoul Ivar the Foul, though Quinn was badly mauled. Ivar lurks nearby, keeping the two Deathstalkers cornered. Their rescue draws the Forsaken into a deeper struggle with the feral threats beyond the road.

faq.q: Who are Rane and Quinn Yorick?
faq.answer: Rane and Quinn Yorick are Forsaken scouts in the Deathstalkers, the Forsaken’s intelligence and assassination wing. They went to survey Silverpine Forest’s farmsteads and then disappeared.

faq.q: Why is High Executor Hadrec concerned about them?
faq.answer: High Executor Hadrec oversees Forsaken military operations from the Sepulcher. With two scouts missing, the Forsaken have no reports on hostile activity along their northern borders, where the Scourge still lingers.

aliases: where to find rane and quinn
faq.answer: The Yoricks disappeared while scouting northern Silverpine Forest. Their route led through the decaying farmsteads north of the Sepulcher.

faq.q: What threats do the Deathstalkers face in northern Silverpine?
faq.answer: Scourge remnants, aggressive predators, and feral worgen threaten scouts in northern Silverpine. Any can kill those who travel alone.

faq.q: What happens after finding the missing Deathstalkers?
faq.answer: Finding Rane Yorick leads you to help the injured scouts recover through Wild Hearts. That brings you against local threats such as Ivar the Foul.

faq.q: Who are the Deathstalkers as an organization?
faq.answer: The Deathstalkers are the Forsaken’s corps of spies, scouts, and assassins. They serve the Dark Lady as her secretive vanguard across Lordaeron.

angles.text: As a Forsaken, you know each missing agent may leave a gap in Silverpine’s fragile defenses. Finding your kin helps keep the Sepulcher safe from sudden attack.
As a rogue, you know the Yoricks as fellow operatives of the shadows. Their plight shows that stealth cannot always protect even seasoned Deathstalkers from northern dangers.
As a member of the Horde, you know Silverpine Forest guards a safe corridor between Undercity and southern Lordaeron. Reconnaissance helps protect that route.
